title: The Cantilevered Modernist Manor
tagline: Sculptural interlocking volumes with grey ledgestone cladding and skylight pergola
description: A prime suburban residence in Bhilai defined by bold horizontal cantilevers, split-level car porch, natural stone cladding, and a rooftop skylight lounge. The perimeter boundary wall integrates warm ambient wash lighting that enhances the curb appeal at night.

details.Key Elements: Double Covered Portico, Ledgestone Accent Walls, Skylight Cutouts, Integrated Landscape
